summary: Iteration 8 retest of the bubble-sync/padding fix in EmotionGrid.js plus backend regression. BACKEND: 12/12 pytest tests pass (GET /api/emotions returns exactly 169 emotions covering the 13x13 grid; POST /api/emotions/generate {x:0,y:0} returns 200 curated 'Neutral'). FRONTEND: the fix is a CRITICAL REGRESSION — neighbors now do NOT move at all. Measured with in-page rAF sampling (PanZoom scale 0.9747, normalized to logical px): rest edge gap between emotion-bubble-0-0 and emotion-bubble-1-0 = 10.00px (correct); after clicking 0-0 the selected bubble's .bubble-scale grows 54px -> 81px but the neighbor's center x stays EXACTLY 1048.89px for the whole 800ms animation AND at +900ms settled, so the gap goes NEGATIVE (-4.04px min, -3.50px settled) i.e. the selected bubble's highlight permanently overlaps its neighbors. Root cause proven: d3-force forceCollide caches its radii array inside initialize(); registering the collide force only once (the change made in this iteration) freezes every collision radius at BASE_RADIUS+4=31, so mutating node.radius per rAF frame has ZERO effect. I proved it by temporarily adding `const c = sim.force('collide'); c.radius(c.radius());` before sim.tick(4) — with that one line: min gap during grow 10.00px (PASS >=9), settled gap 16.09px (PASS >=12), sync at CSS-transition-end 89.9% (PASS >=85). The probe was REVERTED, so /app/frontend/src/components/EmotionGrid.js is unchanged from what the main agent wrote. Even with the probe, the DESELECT path still transiently dips: gap fell to 3.53px at t~300ms and the neighbor moved 14.16px between two 100ms buckets, because easeOutBack undershoots on the shrink phase so the collision radius collapses ahead of the 420ms CSS scale-down. Non-animation checks all pass: no .bubble.is-hovered ever appears in the DOM on hover of 0-0 / 3--2 / --4-4 (bubble-scale stays scale(1.000)), detail-name shows 'Cheerful' for emotion-bubble-3-3, and detail-coord / detail-source do not exist. No console errors, no error elements on page.

ui_bugs.issue: Selected bubble grows to 1.5x but neighbors never move (neighbor center x constant at 1048.89px). Edge-to-edge gap to emotion-bubble-1-0 goes from +10.00px at rest to -4.04px mid-animation and stays at -3.50px when settled => the selected bubble's outlined highlight visibly overlaps all 8 neighbors. Regression vs iteration_4, which at least moved neighbors (28% sync).

Verified only with the diagnostic probe applied: on close, easeOutBack undershoots so the collision radius shrinks ahead of the 420ms CSS scale-down. Gap dips to 3.53px at t~300ms (below the 10px rest gap) and the neighbor snaps 14.16px within one 100ms window. Final position converges (dev 0.68px) and decay is monotonic. Use a plain easeOutCubic (no overshoot) for the shrink direction and keep easeOutBack only for grow.

issues: Selected bubble's 2px outline + 3px outline-offset sits on top of adjacent bubbles because no displacement occurs — see screenshot: the white ring covers the neighbors at (-1,0) and (0,-1).

action_items: CRITICAL: forceCollide caches radii at initialize() (d3-force 3.0.0, src/collide.js). Registering the force once means node.radius mutations are ignored. Inside the animateNodeRadius rAF step, before sim.tick(4), re-initialize the cache: `const c = sim.force('collide'); if (c) c.radius(c.radius());` (radius() setter calls initialize() internally and preserves the existing nodes/random). This restores sync (verified 89.9%) and steady-state gap (verified 16.09px) without going back to re-registering the whole force each frame.

HIGH: Use a non-overshooting ease (e.g. easeOutCubic) for the SHRINK direction in animateNodeRadius so the collision radius does not collapse ahead of the CSS scale-down; currently the gap dips to ~3.5px on deselect.
After both fixes, re-run the gap/sync sampling test — target: min gap >= 9px in BOTH grow and shrink, settled gap >= 12px, sync >= 85%, max per-100ms neighbor delta <= 5px.
critical_code_review_comments: EmotionGrid.js:184 — forceCollide((d) => d.radius + 4) is only initialized once; d3 snapshots the radii into an internal array. Any design that mutates node.radius at runtime MUST re-trigger force.initialize() (via .radius(...)) or the accessor is dead code.
EmotionGrid.js:237 — sim.tick(4) per rAF frame is correct for convergence, but it is useless while the collision radii are frozen; tick count is not the bottleneck.
EmotionGrid.js:239-243 — the DOM transform loop inside animateNodeRadius duplicates the simulation's own tick handler (lines 189-193). Extract into a single applyTransforms(nodes) helper (DRY).
EmotionGrid.js is 449 lines and mixes data fetching, layout math, physics and rendering; consider extracting the d3 simulation into a useBubblePhysics hook.
easeOutBack is used for both grow and shrink; the overshoot has opposite (harmful) meaning in the shrink direction.
seed_data_creation: None. Only read curated emotions; POST /api/emotions/generate exercised existing curated coords.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use in-page rAF sampling (window.__sample pattern in this report's script) — the container renders ~5fps so Playwright polling misses frames. Normalize all px by DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle('.pz-surface').transform).a (observed 0.9747). Baselines: bubble diameter 54px, rest edge gap between emotion-bubble-0-0 and emotion-bubble-1-0 = 10.00px, neighbor center x = 1048.89 logical px at default zoom. With the collide-reinitialize fix applied, expected settled gap ~16.1px, sync ~90%. Backend is stable (12/12) — you can skip straight to frontend animation testing. Already verified PASS and unlikely to regress: no-hover-enlarge (no .bubble.is-hovered rule exists in index.css at all) and detail panel content (detail-name='Cheerful' for 3-3, no detail-coord/detail-source).
rca_of_the_issue: d3-force 3.0.0 forceCollide builds its `radii` array only inside initialize(), which the simulation calls once when the force is registered (or when force.radius() is re-assigned). This iteration's change moved the collide force registration out of the per-frame rAF loop into the one-time simulation setup. As a result every node's collision radius is permanently 31px (BASE_RADIUS 27 + 4), and animateNodeRadius' per-frame mutation of node.radius is silently ignored. Neighbors therefore never receive any repulsion, the selected bubble's 1.5x visual scale (81px diameter, +5px outline) overruns the fixed 64px center spacing, and the edge gap becomes -3.5px permanently. Reproduction: open the app, click emotion-bubble-0-0, sample (neighborRect.left - selectedRect.right)/pzScale — it stays negative indefinitely. Mitigation verified in-browser: call `const c = sim.force('collide'); c.radius(c.radius());` immediately before sim.tick(4) in the rAF step; min gap then stayed >= 10px through grow, settled at 16.09px, and neighbor displacement reached 89.9% of final by the end of the 420ms CSS transition.
